verdict.rationale: BigQuery documents an official Python-based `bq` CLI for creating datasets, loading data and querying tables, plus ODBC/JDBC drivers, SDKs and an official open-source MCP server (MCP Toolbox for Databases), so an agent can run SQL with no dashboard. IAM predefined roles and permissions on datasets, tables, views and routines, together with custom daily quotas, give the governance layer. missing for 10: explicit evidence of headless authentication (service accounts/OAuth), documented schema-discovery commands or metadata views, result read-back/output formats, and independent hands-on corroboration of an agent running the full loop.
